release_read.basis: Q3 revenue $203.0M (+41% y/y) against a $178-182M bar (+12-14%) and diluted EPS $0.46 against $0.27-0.29, with FY26 guide ex-PAD raised to $750-760M from $737-757M, above the $745.7M street; into a 25%-of-float short and a 21% October slide this is a clean beat-and-raise that should break the option-implied 17% move on the upside.

release.released_at_note: Released 2026-11-05 after the close (call at 16:30 ET); the exhibit gives no time of day.

guidance.detail: FY26 revenue ex PAD $750-760M (was $737-757M), above the $745.7M street FY number; the bar the stock was pricing was a cut.

call.detail: Call was last night; transcript not read in the time available. Management quote in the release: strongest quarter in company history, record revenue and case volume, before any ENHANCE Part B or DENOVO contribution.

public_reaction.summary: No dated analyst action for 2026-11-06 found in one search; press coverage of the release is positive (record quarter, raise). Retail tone not checked for time.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 78.79 = +14.2% vs prev close 68.98, against my frozen +17% and an implied 17.0%. After-hours 77.00 (+11.6%) then pre-market climbed to 78.79-78.94, range 76.50-80.00: a pre-market that built rather than sagged. 22 prints, 7 in the last 30 minutes, last at 09:14, not stale. Position is +15.7% from entry 68.24.

thesis_check.note: Thesis was a held guide into a crowded short; the company did better, beating revenue and EPS heavily and raising the guide. The seasonality-miss risk the judges held back on did not materialise.

expected.open_lag_note: Active, rising pre-market (7 prints in 30 minutes, last at 09:14) so the open should hold the move; a large gap usually gives some back by 10:00, but an unambiguous beat-and-raise into a 25%-of-float short with the pre-market still under the implied move keeps the fade near a coin flip.

recommendation.limit_basis: The pre-market high, +16.0% vs prev close: inside the pre-market range and just under the option-implied 17% move and my frozen +17% read, a level a short-covering open can reach; unfilled it goes at the close, where a clean beat-and-raise should hold most of the gain.
recommendation.reason: De cijfers zijn duidelijk beter dan verwacht: omzet $203 miljoen tegen ongeveer $180 miljoen verwacht, winst per aandeel $0,46 tegen $0,27, en de jaarprognose is verhoogd. De koers staat voorbeurs al ruim 14% hoger, iets minder dan wat de cijfers rechtvaardigen, en een kwart van de aandelen is short verkocht, dus een extra opwaartse piek na de opening is goed mogelijk. Zet een verkooplimiet op $80,00; wordt die niet geraakt, dan gaat de positie bij het slot weg.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Zakt de voorbeurskoers voor 09:30 terug onder ongeveer $76,50 (het voorbeurslaagste punt), verkoop dan gewoon bij de opening.
